item.title: Nifty, Bank Nifty hit record highs, Sensex up 0.67 pc
item.description: Nifty hit a record high at 26,330 earlier in the day. Its previous high was 26,325. Bank Nifty also surged to a fresh all-time high of 60,152.35, driven by continued strength in the banking pack.

item.title: Under operation Milap, Delhi Police traced 1,303 missing people, children in 2025
item.description: In December alone, the South-West District Police successfully traced 102 missing people, comprising 35 missing or kidnapped children and 67 missing adults. They were traced between December 1 and December 31 through coordinated search operations and intensive fieldwork.

item.title: Man arrested for playing anti-national song on loudspeaker near temple in Palghar
item.description: According to the FIR registered at Naigaon Police Station, Sub-Inspector Pankaj Kilje, while patrolling the area in a private vehicle around 1.30 p.m., heard the anti-national song blaring from Ruhann Hair Cutting Salon in Karamdpada, located opposite the Durga Mata Mandir.

item.title: Celebs' 2026 NYE photo dump: Virat Kohli–Anushka Sharma party with family, Anil Kapoor raises toast, Vijay–Rashmika cuddle in Rome
item.description: Here's a look at celebrities' and cricketers' New Year photo dump, all about love, hugs, cuddles, kisses, fun, food, family and fans! Fans went crazy upon seeing two photos Virat shared of him and Anushka within a span of 24 hours. Indeed, a happy New Year moment for fans.

item.title: Dhurandhar box office collection: Ranveer Singh's film emerges highest grosser of 2025
item.description: Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar has collected Rs 115.70 crore net at the indian box office in its fourth week. Its 28 days total collection stands at Rs 780 crore net.

item.title: Tanya Mittal owns over 150 bodyguards? Bigg Boss 19 contestants sets record straight
item.description: Bigg Boss 19 contestant Tanya Mittal has addressed the claims around her having 150 bodyguards.
